授業概要
データ分析がどのように利用されるかの具体例を，プログラム実装を意識ながら解説するとともに，画像解析など「目で見てわかりやすい」メディア処理を通して学ぶ． 詳細については，開講時期が近づくと「学生ポータル」にて全学に連絡する．
This class will cover the practical technique of data analysis learned at the lecture ‘Basic techniques for data science’. In this class, the data analysis will be applied in several examples. In order to easily understand how to use the analysis techniques, the process of the analysis is visualized using graphs in the practices. The target students of this lecture are who need data analysis for their research but they do not major in informatics science. The details of the course will be announced in Student Portal.
